notes.title: Aria Skies Is Out Now!
notes.content:
[h3]Thanks everyone for waiting, Aria Skies has officially released! ☁️🎉[/h3]

This marks version 1.0.0 of the game. I'm quite pleased with the end result, and I hope everyone has a good time playing this fighting game, whether in singleplayer or with together with friends. Enjoy all the game has to offer, from the six playable characters, to the various battle modes, to even Gallery mode! Now that the game has released I would really like to know what people think, so don't be afraid to leave a review or comment!

When I started working on this game I wasn't sure if I was going to be able to complete such a monumental project all by myself, but here we are today. It's been an absolute blast solving the unique challenges this genre of game presents!

The game launches with an Arcade mode, featuring CPU-controlled opponents, something I never thought I'd be able to make for the game. This is just one of those challenges that are a great feat to overcome. 

Again, I hope you enjoy Aria Skies! Let's Reach new heights!

notes.title: CPU Modes and Release Window Announcement
notes.content:
[h1]Aria Skies will have CPU battles![/h1]

I'm excited to announce that the game will include battles against CPU character on launch! This effort means players can enjoy singleplayer content whenever they want! Prepare to fight computer-controller opponents in Arcade mode or free battle! I hope you look forward to it!

And also, Aria Skies will release this coming February! I am excited to hear your feedback on the game when it launches!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021375/f16debbfc7572d054bc0fc4bd6e95cb677d23c5d.png[/img]

notes.title: Aria Skies Demo Release!
notes.content:
[h1]The demo is officially released![/h1]
Download the demo now and get a taste of the action before the game releases in 2025!

The demo features:
- 3 playable characters.
- 3 stages.
- Configurable game rules.
- Training mode.

The full game will release with more characters, stages, polish and balance changes!
I hope you enjoy the Aria Skies demo!
